name: English Teaching Visa
description: The E-2 visa is for qualified English teachers from English-speaking countries working at Korean language institutes, public schools, or private academies (hagwons).
keyRequirement: Bachelor's degree + citizenship from English-speaking country
targetAudience: Native English speakers with bachelor's degrees

restrictions: Teaching English only at sponsored institution
workPermission.notes: Cannot work outside of teaching position without separate permission

pathsTo.name: Professional Employment Visa
pathsTo.requirements: Secure a professional job offer from a Korean company outside of teaching. Must meet E-7 qualifications (degree + relevant experience).
pathsTo.notes: For English teachers wanting to transition to professional work (IT, business, etc.). May require additional qualifications or experience beyond teaching. A new employer must sponsor your visa.

pathsTo.name: Job Seeking Visa
pathsTo.requirements: Must have bachelor's degree. Apply before E-2 visa expires or within the grace period after contract ends.
pathsTo.notes: A bridge option for teachers who want to explore other career paths in Korea. D-10 gives you up to 2 years to find new employment outside teaching.

pathsFrom.name: Working Holiday Visa
pathsFrom.requirements: Citizenship from an English-speaking country (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NZ, Ireland, South Africa). Bachelor's degree required. Secure a teaching job at a hagwon or school.
pathsFrom.notes: Some Working Holiday visa holders transition to teaching positions. The E-2 requires citizenship from specific English-speaking countries, not just English fluency.
